name: @gnomevpn/tauri
description: GnomeVPN desktop and Android shell — Tauri 2 over the privileged VPN service.
author: Alexandr Artemev

scripts.predev: bun run kill && bun run singbox && node ./scripts/sync-bin.mjs && node ./scripts/build-service.mjs && bun run icon
scripts.prebuild: bun run singbox && node ./scripts/sync-bin.mjs && node ./scripts/build-service.mjs --release && bun run icon
scripts.android:init: bun run hysteria && bun --env-file .env tauri android init && bun run icon && node ./scripts/setup-android-libs.mjs
scripts.android:dev: bun run hysteria && bun run icon && node ./scripts/setup-android-libs.mjs && bun --env-file .env tauri android dev
scripts.android:build: bun run hysteria && bun run icon && node ./scripts/setup-android-libs.mjs && node ./scripts/check-api-url.mjs && bun --env-file .env tauri android build --apk
